title: 流水句的分句
goal: 能依据主体、时间和意义划分句界并组织分句。

points.label: 依据主体与意义层次划分句界
选择关系清楚且信息完整的分句方式

sources.title: 大学英语六级考试大纲

body.p: 中文流水句用逗号把几个事件连成一句。译成英文时，按主语变化、时间转移和意义层次断句。几个独立分句可以各成一句，也可以用连接词或从句合并。

body.box:
原文：天色渐暗，游客离开山谷，工作人员关闭了入口。
译文：It grew dark. The visitors left the valley, and the staff closed the entrance.

cards.title: 句界的依据
rows: 主语变化
工匠整理工具，学徒清扫地面，工作室在傍晚关门。
工匠、学徒和工作室分别是主体。
时间转移
清晨工人检查设备，中午开始作业，傍晚机器停了下来。
按清晨、中午和傍晚区分事件。
意义层次
雨停后道路仍然湿滑，车辆减速，行人沿路边行走。
雨停是时间背景，其余事件是主要信息。
独立句标点
水位上升，渡船停航，乘客在岸边等待。
两个完整句之间用句号或连接词。

cards.title: 拆分与合并
rows: 工匠检查工具，学徒整理木材，工作室随后开门。
The craftsperson checked the tools. The apprentice sorted the wood. The workshop then opened.
After the craftsperson checked the tools and the apprentice sorted the wood, the workshop opened.
清晨薄雾散去，船只离开港口，傍晚船只抵达海岛。
The fog lifted in the morning. The boat left the harbor. It reached the island in the evening.
After the fog lifted in the morning, the boat left the harbor and reached the island in the evening.
雨停后道路仍然湿滑，司机放慢车速，行人沿路边行走。
The rain stopped. The road remained slippery. Drivers slowed down, and pedestrians walked along the roadside.
After the rain stopped, the road remained slippery; drivers slowed down, and pedestrians walked along the roadside.
两句直接相连需标点或连接词。
The rain stopped. The road remained slippery.
After the rain stopped, the road remained slippery.

cards.title: 分句的连接
rows: 句号
The wind rose. The ferry returned to port.
两个独立句分开。
并列连词
The wind rose, and the ferry returned to port.
and 连接两个独立分句。
时间从句
When the wind rose, the ferry returned to port.
when 表示时间关系。
分号
The wind rose; the ferry returned to port.
分号连接相关的独立分句。

items.stem: 原文：学生整理照片，教师检查清单，展览随后开始。选择译句。
options: Students sorted the photos. The teacher checked the list. The exhibition then began.
Students sorted the list. The teacher checked the photos. The exhibition then began.
Students sorted the photos, the teacher checked the list, the exhibition then began.
After the exhibition began, students sorted the photos and the teacher checked the list.
items.why: 原文三个事件的主体不同，第一项各成一句，动作和先后顺序都保留了。第三项用逗号连接三个完整句，标点不对。

items.stem: 原文：雨停后，工人检查屋顶，居民回到房屋。选择译句。
options: After workers checked the roof, rain stopped and residents returned home.
After the rain stopped, workers checked the roof, and residents returned home.
After residents checked the roof, rain stopped and workers returned home.
After the rain stopped, workers checked the roof, residents returned home.
items.why: 雨停是时间背景，用 after 从句表达；工人和居民是两个主体，用 and 连接，即第二项。第四项缺少 and，两个完整句只用逗号相连。

items.stem: 原文：日落后船只靠岸，船员搬运货物。排列译句。
items.why: 船只和船员是不同主体，and 连接两个分句。

items.stem: 原文：雨停后，孩子们离开教室去操场。排列译句。
items.why: After 引出时间从句，主句保留离开和目的地。

items.stem: 原文：早晨雾散了，渡船离港，傍晚抵达海岛。选择译句。
options: The ferry left port and reached the island in the morning. The fog lifted in the evening.
The fog lifted in the morning. The ferry reached the island in the evening.
The fog lifted in the morning. The ferry left port and reached the island in the evening.
The fog lifted in the morning, the ferry left port, it reached the island in the evening.
items.why: 雾散和渡船是两个主体，各成一句；渡船的离港和抵达共用主语，合在第二句，即第三项。第二项漏译了离港。

items.stem: 原文：风力增强后，渡船返回港口，乘客上岸。排列译句。
items.why: after 表示时间背景，and 连接渡船和乘客两个主体的动作。

items.stem: 原文：农民收割谷物，工人清洁仓库，货车随后到达。选择译句。
options: Farmers cleaned the warehouse. Workers harvested grain. The truck arrived later.
Farmers harvested grain, workers cleaned the warehouse, the truck arrived later.
Farmers harvested grain. Workers cleaned the warehouse after the truck arrived.
Farmers harvested grain. Workers cleaned the warehouse. The truck arrived later.
items.why: 农民、工人和货车是三个主体，第四项各成一句，later 保留了随后到达的顺序。第三项把货车到达放到了清洁仓库之前。

items.stem: 原文：清晨雾散去，船离开港口，傍晚到达岛上。选择译句。
options: The fog lifted in the morning. The boat left port and reached the island in the evening.
The fog lifted in the evening. The boat left port and reached the island in the morning.
The fog lifted in the morning. The boat reached the island in the evening.
The fog lifted in the morning, the boat left port, it reached the island in the evening.
items.why: 第一句写清晨雾散，第二句写船的两个动作，清晨和傍晚两个时间都保留了，即第一项。第四项用逗号连接三个完整句。

items.stem: 原文：雪停后，居民清理道路，车辆恢复通行。选择译句。
options: After residents cleared the road, the snow stopped, and traffic resumed.
After the snow stopped, residents cleared the road, and traffic resumed.
After the snow stopped, residents cleared the road, traffic resumed.
After the snow stopped, traffic resumed, and residents cleared the road.
items.why: 雪停是时间背景，用 after 从句；居民清理道路和车辆恢复通行按原文顺序用 and 连接，即第二项。第四项颠倒了这两件事的顺序。

items.stem: 原文：展览结束后，游客离开展厅，工作人员关门。选择译句。
options: After visitors left the gallery, the exhibition ended, and staff closed the doors.
After the exhibition ended, staff left the gallery, and visitors closed the doors.
After the exhibition ended, visitors left the gallery, and staff closed the doors.
After the exhibition ended, visitors left the gallery, staff closed the doors.
items.why: 展览结束是时间背景，用 after 从句；游客离开和工作人员关门是两个主体的动作，用 and 连接，即第三项。第二项把两个动作的主体互换了。

items.stem: 原文：太阳落山后，渔船返航，船员搬运渔获。排列译句。
items.why: boat 和 crew 分别是两个分句的主语。

items.stem: 原文：暴雨停止后，道路仍然湿滑，司机减速。排列译句。
items.why: 时间从句之后，road 和 drivers 分别承担两个分句的动作。

items.stem: 原文：演出结束后，演员谢幕，观众鼓掌。排列译句。
items.why: after 引出时间背景，and 连接演员和观众两个分句。

items.stem: 原文：图书馆开放后，学生进入阅览室借书。排列译句。
items.why: after 从句表示图书馆开放，主句保留学生的动作和目的。
